notes.title: Update #10
notes.content:
A couple of additional fixes and tweaks.

Firstly, as a response from player, Hairy Mary, I have reduced the mouse sensitivity by 50%. Hopefully, this will make for a smoother experience.

Level 01 - The Lost Valley
Flipped the notes around on both monoliths so that the player finds the note relating to collecting fairy rings and rock piles first.

Level 02 - The Swamplands
Fixed a disappearing and re-appearing bush

Level 07 - Snow Caves
Moved the exact respawn point to bring it next to the respawn marker

notes.title: Update #9
notes.content:
Firstly, an apology to players who have encountered an issue with the UI in the second level, The Swamplands.

Thanks to player, Hairy Mary for messaging me and pointing it out.

Long story short, in fixing a problem, I created another, namely forgetting to turn the level UI back on, which would result in no ESC menu and the UI collectable scores being invisible.

Silly mistake, so sorry if this has vexed any players. I've just updated now, and everything is above board again.

Thanks again Mary! ːrarebutterflyː

notes.title: Lost Valley of the Frog King can now be found!
notes.content:
Lost Valley of the Frog King can now be found on Steam!

You are the captain of an arctic expedition. Months into the voyage, you discover an uncharted island, encased in a wall of ice. You decide to take a closer look and meet with your boat on the far side of the island. What will you discover?


Unwind and relax as you explore colourful and atmospheric environments. No story, NPCs, cutscenes or distractions. Just you, exploring environments at your own pace. A super simple collectathon.

notes.title: Lost Valley of the Frog King joins the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339749/86683318d816a6900be2ecafd6bbd05855607e08.jpg[/img]

This Monday, discover the Lost Valley of the Frog King, as it joins the Steam Next Fest!

You will be able to play the first level from the game. The whole game releases March 5th.

In this demo, explore an uncharted island, encased in a wall of ice. Be the first person to set foot in the lost valley. Explore lush woodlands, crystal caves and find the secrets that lead deeper into the island.

Unwind and relax as you explore colourful and atmospheric environments. No story, NPCs, cutscenes or distractions. Just you, exploring environments at your own pace. A super simple collectathon.
